title: About AET
description: Explore AET’s history, awards, memberships and services. Founded in Miami in 2009, AET provides translation and international credential evaluation services.
intro: Founded in 2009 by translation and international credential evaluation expert Mr. Jeremy Yan. His professional experience dates back to 1997.

timeline.body: Founded in Miami, FL. Became an American Translators Association (ATA) member.
Member of National Association for College Admission Counseling.
timeline.linkLabel: National Association for College Admission Counseling

timeline.body: “People love American Education & Translation Services on Yelp!” award.
San Francisco Office opened. Los Angeles Office opened.
Our owner, Jeremy Yan, became a member of Association of International Educators (NAFSA).
Approved Credential Evaluation Source by Illinois State Board of Education.
Approved Credential Evaluation agency by New Mexico Public Education Department.
Approved Credential Evaluation agency by Ohio State Board of Education.

highlights.title: Recognition
highlights.body: “People love American Education & Translation Services, LLC on Yelp!” award in 2016.

highlights.title: Experience
highlights.body: Founded in 2009 by translation and international credential evaluation expert Mr. Jeremy Yan. His professional experience dates back to 1997.

highlights.title: ATA membership
highlights.body: Corporate Member of American Translators Association (ATA) since 2009.

highlights.title: 100+ languages
highlights.body: Translation services between English and more than 100 languages: Chinese, Spanish, French, German, Russian, Arabic, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, etc.

highlights.title: Certified translations
highlights.body: Served over 10,000 CERTIFIED TRANSLATIONS to USCIS, ECFMG, US school systems, US courts, etc.

highlights.title: Online and in person
highlights.body: Convenient online service & walk in to our multiple offices in Miami, Boston, San Francisco, and Los Angeles, and Beijing, China.

highlights.title: Personal support
highlights.body: Reliable and reasonable service fees. Very easy to call and email to our offices and experienced reps.

highlights.title: Rush services
highlights.body: Rush services available for selected languages.

highlights.title: Chinese interpretation
highlights.body: Powerful and localized Chinese interpretation services.

highlights.title: Our team
highlights.body: Highly qualified and bilingual in house employees. Experienced translators across the world.
